segments.originalStructuredText: Are You greater than our father Abraham? He died, as did the prophets. Who do You claim to be?”

segments.text: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’
segments.originalStructuredText: Jesus answered, “If I glorify Myself, My glory means nothing. The One who glorifies Me is My Father, of whom you say, ‘He is our God.’

segments.text: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.
segments.originalStructuredText: You do not know Him, but I know Him. If I said I did not know Him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know Him, and I keep His word.

segments.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”
segments.originalStructuredText: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he would see My day. He saw it and was glad.”

segments.text: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”
segments.originalStructuredText: Then the Jews said to Him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and You have seen Abraham?”

segments.text: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
segments.originalStructuredText: “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus declared, “before Abraham was born, I am!”

segments.text: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
segments.originalStructuredText: At this, they picked up stones to throw at Him. But Jesus was hidden and went out of the temple area.
